articles.title: Why Dogs in Old Paintings Are Secret Superstars
articles.summary: A new book shows how dogs in famous paintings do more than look cute—they help us see the world through their eyes. From a puppy in a 1501 painting to a dog as a kid’s chair, these furry friends break down walls between humans and animals.

articles.title: Poop at a Concert? This Singer Has a Funny Request
articles.summary: At Noah Kahan’s show in Philadelphia, someone left poop on the floor by the seats. The singer joked on X that fans should just use the bathroom—and even admitted he once pooped his pants on stage! A worker was left with a “1000 yard stare.”

articles.title: Serena Williams Is Back! How to Watch Wimbledon for Free
articles.summary: Wimbledon starts Monday, and Serena Williams returns as a wild card—her first Grand Slam since 2022! You can watch for free with trials from DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV, or Fubo. Matches air on ESPN, ESPN2, and ABC.
